## Review checklist
- [ ] Domain code uses no framework, database or HTTP classes
- [ ] Money is integer minor units, never float
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, including the failure case
- [ ] `composer ci` passes locally
- [ ] Docs or ADR updated if a design decision changed
- [ ] No secrets or real customer data in the diff
